core: Th1 differentiation of CD4 T cells
name: IL-12-driven Th1 differentiation and helper lineage choice
rationale: Members cover IL-12/IFN-gamma-driven Th1 differentiation plus competing Treg, Th17 and memory fate decisions, which separates the theme from dendritic/NKT-cell and IFN-gamma-response confusables.

core: Transcriptional control by promoter DNA binding
name: Promoter-binding control of cadherin and TGFBR3 transcription
rationale: Members concern regulation of transcription factor DNA binding and initiation, with the named targets CDH1, CDH11 and TGFBR3, distinguishing it from RUNX3/FOXO transcription and from EMT/adhesion confusables.

name: Tachykinin PLC-calcium signalling in reproductive function
rationale: Members share PLC-coupled GPCR/calcium signalling (tachykinin receptors, GnRH response) and reproductive outputs (erection, insemination, uterine contraction, parturition), unlike the urinary/gut smooth-muscle and adenylate-cyclase confusables.

name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation and myocardial wall growth
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation, survival, hypertrophy, regeneration and ventricular/trabecular myocardium morphogenesis, unlike confusables centred on early heart patterning, valves, conduction, vasculature or muscle adaptation.

core: Golgi structure and endosomal membrane dynamics
name: ARF/Rab GTPase control of Golgi structure and endocytic recycling
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon disassembly/reassembly, COPI budding, endosome tubulation and receptor recycling under ARF/Rab GTPase regulation, whereas confusables are about Golgi-ER/endosome-Golgi retrograde routes and lysosomal delivery.

qualifier: coupled to complex II and ATP synthesis
name: TCA cycle coupled to complex II and ATP synthesis
rationale: Members are TCA-cycle intermediates and steps plus succinate-ubiquinone electron transfer and ATP synthesis, distinguishing it from PDH/CoA, malate-aspartate shuttle and glutamate-metabolism confusables.

name: Combined T- and B-lymphocyte development transcriptional signatures
rationale: All members are lymphocyte development/activation expression signatures spanning T cells, thymocytes and B-cell differentiation, unlike the B-cell-only, thymic-selection and T-activation confusables.

qualifier: ear, nose, taste and cranial nerves
name: Cranial sensory organ and nerve development (ear, nose, taste)
rationale: Members build the ear, nose/olfactory system, taste papillae and associated cranial nerves and ganglia, distinguishing it from face/skull morphogenesis, gland, hindbrain motor and hair-cell fate confusables.

name: Calcium-dependent adherens junction assembly
rationale: All three members concern calcium-dependent cell-cell adhesion and assembly of adherens junctions, versus confusables on junction maintenance, cadherin turnover, polarity or general cell junctions.

name: Dolichol-linked oligosaccharide assembly and congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members are dolichol, GDP-mannose and lipid-linked oligosaccharide synthesis and their CDG defects, unlike confusables on sialic acid/UDP-GlcNAc, N-glycan processing, nucleotide-sugar transport or GPI anchors.

name: Axo-dendritic microtubule transport of mitochondria and vesicles
rationale: Members are microtubule-based transport of neuronal cargoes (mitochondria, dense-core and synaptic vesicles, receptor complexes), whereas confusables emphasise kinesin machinery, tubulin modification, microtubule severing or organelle size.

name: Epithelial apical protein sorting and CFTR-mediated anion transport
rationale: Members cover Golgi-to-plasma membrane, raft and apical/basolateral sorting plus CFTR trafficking and anion/water transport, distinguishing it from bile-transporter, microvillus/tight-junction and ion-channel confusables.

qualifier: beta-catenin phosphodegron and AXIN missense mutants
name: Oncogenic beta-catenin phosphodegron and AXIN missense mutants
rationale: All members are point mutants of CTNNB1 phosphosites or AXIN that escape destruction-complex control, unlike confusables with APC truncations, AXIN1 deletions or normal Wnt signalling steps.

name: AU-rich element-mediated mRNA decay and translational control
rationale: Members are 3'-UTR/ARE-binding proteins (TTP, AUF1, KSRP, BRF1, HuR) and translational silencing, distinguishing it from immediate-early gene, RNA editing, stress-granule and CRD-stabilisation confusables.

name: HSF1 heat shock and mitochondrial unfolded protein responses
rationale: Members are HSF1 activation/attenuation, heat acclimation, protein refolding and UPRmt, unlike FOXO, ER folding, protein acetylation and stress-granule confusables.

name: Proline, glycine and glyoxylate amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are amino/organic acid metabolism with specific proline, glycine and glyoxylate pathways, distinguishing it from aromatic/histidine/threonine catabolism and glycine-conjugation confusables.

name: GPVI collagen-receptor platelet activation and aggregation control
rationale: Members are platelet activation signatures, GPVI signalling and positive/negative regulation of aggregation, unlike confusables on VWF/GPIb adhesion or ADP, thrombin and thromboxane GPCR signalling.
Members mix regulation of hypoxia and oxidative-stress responses, antibiotic/drug responses and developmental apoptosis, with no specific process common to all five.

name: Canonical Notch target-gene transcription (HES/HEY)
rationale: All members describe transcriptional output of Notch signalling onto HLH targets, whereas confusables cover receptor processing, paralog-specific activation or oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants.

name: Protein lysine acetylation and HSF1 heat shock response
rationale: Members combine histone/lysine/N-terminal acetylation and tubulin deacetylation control with acetylation-regulated HSF1 heat shock activation and attenuation, distinguishing it from refolding/UPRmt, chromatin assembly and methylation confusables.

name: ER-associated degradation and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members cover ERAD regulation, misfolded-protein responses, E3 ligases, Josephin DUBs and reticulophagy, unlike aggrephagy, ribosome quality control and ubiquitin-chain-type confusables.

name: Gonadal sex determination and reproductive tract and prostate development
rationale: Members span sex determination, gonad and AMH signalling, prostate, uterus, oviduct, vagina and genitalia development, distinguishing it from mammary, germ-cell/seminiferous and pancreatic confusables.

name: Chemokine ligand-receptor gene clusters and leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members are chemokine and chemokine-receptor sets driving leukocyte chemotaxis, including monocyte and NK cells, unlike dendritic-cell CCR7, lymphocyte-homing and CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte confusables.

qualifier: IL-20 family, keratinocyte proliferation and migration
name: IL-20-family keratinocyte proliferation and migration in wound healing
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte/epithelial proliferation and migration, epidermal spreading and wound inflammation, with IL-20 family signalling distinguishing it from keratinocyte-differentiation and migration-inhibition confusables.

name: Platelet adhesion, activation and degranulation in hemostasis
rationale: Members cover GPIb/GPVI adhesion signalling, platelet activation, aggregation and degranulation, unlike confusables on VWF variants, ADP P2Y signalling or the plasma coagulation cascade.
